correctness.rationale: All thirteen-word admissible codes have unique-plane supports by tight Hamming incidence bounds and double counting; all incidence colorings are admissible. The normalized-plane backtracking tests every remaining line permutation, exact 80,640. Independent Singer difference-set matching decomposition gives 1,935,360 full colorings. Generated group has 5616 elements, direct orbits give 12×5616+7×1872+1×144=80640 and Burnside conjugacy fixed-point sum 112320 yields twenty classes. All 20 explicit representative code sets passed direct weight and Hamming checks. Known size13 and uniqueness of PG(2,3) are explicitly attributed.

value.rationale: The sharp 13-word code problem previously had constructions and optimal code size. Its complete equality census reduces 2.1459 trillion labeled code designs to twenty color-geometric types; this is an exact naturally motivated classification rather than a numerical parameter tweak or a routine known-table recomputation. Explicit representatives and independent methods make the classification reusable for design and equivalence comparisons.
